digest.component_or_area: CI test infrastructure / pytest performance audit
propositions: An exhaustive audit enumerates every pytest phase ≥1.0s across three recent CI runs and one current-main local census pass, totaling 501 normalized ≥1s nodes and their keep/refactor/move disposition.

Gerrit 1817 removes 19 OS/Python-invariant repository-policy nodes from macOS/Ubuntu 3.11/3.12 while retaining them in Ubuntu 3.13, saving ~8s macOS wall and 24.84 aggregate runner-seconds without new job/setup/runner overhead.

No individual pytest phase exceeds 30s in CI or local census; the measured maximum is 22.63s (show under write burst); all 501 inventoried nodes have documented unique coverage rationale, prior ticket decisions, and safe keep/refactor/move recommendations.

Real external analyzer, Git concurrency, partial-clone, import/packaging, signing/identity, and platform-specific filesystem/socket/subprocess behavior are retained because mocks cannot provide equivalent confidence; proposed research and equivalence experiments are recorded.

macOS-to-Ubuntu routing beyond the landed Gerrit 1817 is rejected because remaining candidate families contain platform behavior not provably invariant; no new shard/job is approved because prior experiments increased job-minutes 18.6→21.0 and contention 22.3→25.2.

Ranked next actions include approved test-only window/clock shortening (songful-groovelike-horsemouse), equivalence research (lead-unpleasing-kitten, reasonable-kingsize-polliwog, rival-ammoniacal-crustacean), and monitoring of N=3000 import and real concurrency suites pending organic descendant post-1817 measurement.
